title: myrtus foetida
intro: Myrtus foetida, commonly known as Indian leaf myrtle, is a plant species in the family Myrtaceae. It is used in traditional medicine due to its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of M. foetida include wound healing, treating respiratory issues, and managing digestive problems, attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids. The bioactive constituents of M. foetida are responsible for its medicinal properties, including flavonoids like quercetin and kaempferol, alkaloids like berberine, and phenolic acids like ferulic and sinapic acid.
